title: Chapter 2937 - 171: Carving the Life Formation (Part 3)
content:
Chapter 2937: Chapter 171: Carving the Life Formation (Part 3)

His original intention was simply to use the "Twelve Scripture Gluttonous Spirit Corpse Formation" as his Lifebound Formation.

However, using the "Twelve Scripture Gluttonous Spirit Corpse Formation" alone as a Lifebound Formation was impossible for Mo Hua.

His body could not bear the Bone Carving Formation.

His already weak Blood Qi would significantly deplete.

The Taotie’s Law also lacked sustenance.

Mo Hua could only find solutions by himself to solve these problems one by one. Finally, after exhausting his brains to piece together things from here and there, he managed to "patch up" a "strange thing":

The "Wood White Gold Jade Bone-Wood Revitalization Formation-Taotie Spiritual Bone Pattern" three-in-one framework of the Lifebound Formation.

On the surface, the Taotie Spirit Remains Formation is naturally his Lifebound Formation.

But to bear this Absolute Formation, Mo Hua used two other key "inheritances."

Mo Hua was unsure whether doing so would lead to other issues.

But now, there was no turning back.

Once an arrow is released, there’s no turning back. On this path of "Core Formation," he could only rely on himself, braving forward until the end...

Yet, this cultivation theory fundamentally remains a concept.

Many times, to truly implement these concepts and turn the cultivation theory from idea to reality is the hardest part.

To perfectly construct this set of Bone-and-Blood-and-Formation "Formation System" upon himself, Mo Hua also spent too much Heart Spirit.

He roamed throughout the Qian Learning State Boundary, studied the Core Formation doctrines of the Three Tai Xu Sects, became a Shaman in the Great Wilderness, and perused countless tribal classics.

At this moment, connecting all these insights, Mo Hua was sleepless and forgetful of food, exhausting his Divine Sense through countless deductions, only then finally constructing an entire set of "knife carving formation" plans most feasible for him presently.

First, Mo Hua had started preparing the foundation of Wood White Gold Jade Bone early on.

Since the battle of Divine Blessing began, even before he headed for the campaign, he had begun continuously consuming Spiritual Objects of gold and wood types, nourishing his flesh in preparation for the Lifebound Formation "knife carving."

Now, his flesh had been preliminary nourished.

His bones had already faintly presented the color of golden jade.

With Sishen’s assistance, he also completed the validation of the Twelve Scripture Gluttonous Spirit Corpse Formation.

Mo Hua truly reached the time to "carve" himself.

At this moment, at the center of the hidden cave lay a complicatedly constructed formation "penalty bed."

This was prepared by Mo Hua for himself.

He needed to "carve" himself, during which there would undoubtedly be intense pain, making the flesh hard to control its trembling. Therefore, he must use formations to forcibly fix his body.

Additionally, being able to endure intense pain while painting formations on oneself was also a great challenge.

This task could not be entrusted to others.

He only could paint it himself; no one else could help him.

One reason being that the Second Grade Twenty-four Patterns Twelve Scripture Gluttonous Spirit Corpse Formation was known by Mo Hua alone to be "the living person" capable of painting it.

He also needed to employ special "Bone Carving" techniques.

He could not find anyone else on earth capable of carving this Taotie Absolute Array onto him.

Even if someone like this existed, equipped with the Taotie Absolute Array, Mo Hua could not let them paint it for him.

Because this was the "Lifebound Formation," the foundation of his Core Formation and the future cultivation path.

This is the most confidential, most fundamental secret for a cultivator; it must never be shared with others nor experienced by a second person unless absolutely necessary.

Not even Elder Master Xun, his master, his parents, or closest ones should be too involved.

This is not due to distrust, but rather the ramifications of cause and effect are too great.

The Lifebound Formation practices Life and Spirit Cultivation, both his "Dao" and his "Life."

His life must be held in his own hands.

Giving his life to others would incur enormous risks and would entangle them in cause and effect.

Especially for Mo Hua, who knows his Life Chart and cause are drastically different from ordinary people; the dangers and crisis within are like a boundless abyss, unfathomable.

His causes, his Dao, and his life, if solely held in his own hands, mean others aiming to harm his Dao or his life will confront only him.

But if he were to share his life-critical issues with his parents, relatives, friends, and mentors,

They would also bear this share of cause and effect for him.

Others might leverage them to "harm" him.

Conversely, it means he "harms" them.

Even worse, his parents are merely ordinary cultivators.

He wishes for only happiness and peace for them throughout life, unwilling to let them bear too much of his cause, possibly bringing about unexpected calamities.

So, some things are meant for him alone.

Some life is meant to be held by only one’s self.

This is not due to distrust of others but wholly to avoid entangling and harming them.

The present "alone" situation is indeed the best condition.

Throughout the Barbaric Wilderness, Mo Hua as the mysterious Divine Blessing Lord is actually a "Heaven-sent person," a complete "stranger."

Almost no one truly knows his origins.

Therefore, all causes of his Core Formation can be gathered within himself and not involve others.

All formations, spell points, causes, and specific processes related to his Core Formation are almost only known by himself.

In another sense, Divine Blessing is Divine Blessing, Mo Hua is Mo Hua.

It is presently the Barbaric Wilderness’s "Divine Blessing" Lord, who is forging the Lifebound Formation, preparing for Core Formation.

Not Mo Hua.

Not that Mo Hua, as Mr. Zhuang’s disciple, the Junior Formation master of Tongxian City, Junior Brother of Taixu Gate, Little Ancestor of the Three Tai Xu Sects, Qianxue Formation Path Double Champion, Sword Discussion Champion of Qianxue...

...

Mo Hua calmed his Heart Spirit, swallowing a bottle of potion brewed from the Barbaric Wilderness "Masheng Grass."

Masheng Grass has a paralytic effect, able to paralyze senses, suppress the flesh’s pain.

After that, Mo Hua took off the holy robe of Divine Blessing. His body, fair and delicate, with inner bones emitting a golden jade-like lustrous glow, pure and sacred.

Mo Hua mixed the essence of Wood White and the marrow of golden jade, pouring it into a jade vessel.

He then lay upon the formation "penalty bed" he crafted for himself.

The light flowed, the formation operated, and the instrument matched, nailing Mo Hua firmly onto the bed, unable to move even amidst the greatest pain.

Meanwhile, the shackles on hands and feet grow dense spikes stabbing into Mo Hua’s flesh, as blood flowed, piercing into his Hand San Yin, Hand San Yang, Three Yin Legs, and Three Yang Legs, a total of twelve meridians...
